## Motivation

Why this question matters, in prose. What would a resolution (in either
direction) change about what's known.

## Provenance and history

Where this question comes from: the original source, prior partial results,
who has worked on it, and how the current statements in this hub relate to
that history.

## Parameter lattice

The independent dimensions along which statements in this family vary. Each
cell links to the leaf occupying that point; an empty cell is a research
prompt (a combination nobody has stated or attempted yet), not an omission
-- mark it "unstated" rather than leaving it blank.

Replace the two example axes and the 2x2 body below with the axes that
actually vary in this hub (there can be more than two; add rows/columns or a
third table as needed).

| | Axis B = value 1 | Axis B = value 2 |
|---|---|---|
| **Axis A = value 1** | [c/0000](/c/0000/) | *unstated* |
| **Axis A = value 2** | *unstated* | [c/0000](/c/0000/) |
